name: LSP
description: Code intelligence from language servers: definition, references, implementations, hover, document and workspace symbols, and diagnostics for a file. Use it for symbols and types. Use Grep for plain text and configuration. Give line (1-based, as shown by Read) plus symbol (the identifier on that line, preferred) or character (1-based column). A status of pending means the server has not answered yet; it does not mean there are no errors.

operation.description: goToDefinition/findReferences/hover/goToImplementation need line plus symbol (preferred) or character; documentSymbol and diagnostics need only filePath; workspaceSymbol needs query.

filePath.description: File to query, absolute or relative to the working directory. For workspaceSymbol, any file of the target language (selects the server).

line.description: 1-based line number, as shown by Read.

character.description: 1-based column on the line. Prefer symbol instead; give exactly one of them.

symbol.description: Identifier on the given line; its first whole-word occurrence is used.

includeDeclaration.description: findReferences: also return the declaration. Defaults to false.
